name: Event Horizon Battlefront Aditiya
overview: Event Horizon Battlefront Aditya is a cosmic-themed light novel project and part of the Shinza Bansho series created by Masada Paradise (Takashi Masada). Set during the "Age of Zero" before the creation of the Divine Throne, the story follows six youths and four factions clashing over the "Land of the Beginning" and the pursuit of true immortality.
